Does category A contain the entire category B?

Each title names a topic of discussion, not merely a type of object or action. Preserve its full scope, including the details and relationships stated in the title.

Interpret names, labels, and hashtags by what they refer to; their component words alone do not establish a literal description. If a title's meaning is unresolved and affects the containment decision, answer "uncertain" rather than inventing an interpretation.
